title: OPT五阶段复盘+身体成分与心肺评估
requirements: All accepted sources are PNGs with a real alpha channel and were visually checked on a neutral background.
Each accepted scene has exactly one Bojji and one Despa, no readable text, numbers, readings, ground, room, cast shadow, duplicate pose, route or sequence framing.
Assessment scenes remain neutral and non-diagnostic: no person is weighed, measured, scanned, ridden on the bicycle or made to perform the low-step action.
Overview art is independently generated and compositionally distinct from its corresponding knowledge image.

accepted.review: One upright Bojji and one upright Despa calmly consider an unmarked card and plain tape beside an unused isolated stationary bicycle; no test, reading or body judgment is depicted.
One card has four non-symbolic empty compartments and one shoe; the single present scene is a selection discussion, not a staged progression.
Despa holds a blank tabletop scale and unmarked coiled tape while Bojji remains at a respectful distance; neither tool measures a person and neither has a readable result.
Blank three-compartment card, caliper-like prop and blank handheld device remain separate from both people; there is no measurement, scan or medical setting.
Bojji is beside, not on, the complete stable low wooden platform; the record card is blank and no step, walk, timing or testing sequence appears.
Calm open-palm pause and a respectfully lowered blank record card make a non-emergency consent boundary; the bicycle is unused and isolated.
Compact close composition with the four-cell card and shoe is independently framed from visual-01 and contains no progression markers.
Side-on Bojji remains away from the scale; scale display is blank and no reading, person-on-scale or waist measurement is shown.
The card, caliper-like tool and blank device are presented as separate method props; an open hand emphasizes a boundary without a clinical or measurement scene.
New compact layout keeps Bojji clearly beside the freestanding low platform and Despa holding a blank card, with no stepping or test execution.
Independent compact pause scene with one open palm, one blank card and an unused bike; the interaction is calm rather than urgent.

rejected.reason: Despa kneels beside a tape with visible graduations, contrary to the upright non-measurement cover direction.
The scale has a visible dial/pointer and the tape has visible markings, so it can be read as an actual result-bearing measurement tool.
Bojji's tense raised-fist pose and kneeling Despa can be read as conflict or an incident instead of a calm consent pause.
